OpenMLS deletes the one-time KeyPackage in keys_for_welcome (fork creation.rs:688-713), called from ProcessedWelcome::new_from_welcome (:156), i.e. before mimid gets any ProcessedWelcome/JoinBuilder to inspect. Documented in mimi-mls # Limitations meanwhile. Options for Mark: (1) fork change: defer delete_key_package from keys_for_welcome to into_group (needs fork-write approval; upstreamable); (2) scratch dry-run: copy the KeyPackageBundle into a throwaway in-memory provider, stage there, run mimid checks, join for real only on acceptance (double decrypt/verify, private key copied in memory, resumption-PSK Welcomes would be wrongly refused); (3) document only (done) and let the agent upload a replacement KeyPackage.","status":"open"}
